scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: At [00:00], the agent opened with 'thank you for contacting S-Net' instead of the mandatory exact greeting 'thank you for calling S-Net'.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: At [04:18], the agent deflected responsibility to the third-party courier instead of raising an internal fulfilment escalation, telling the customer there was nothing she could do and to contact the DHL depot directly.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: At [04:00] and [05:37], the agent failed to ask any diagnostic probing questions or check whether a credit-vetting hold, out-of-stock flag, or unsigned multi-room contract agreement was blocking dispatch.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: At [12:22]-[12:53], the call ended with the Ultra TV multi-room mini box still stuck in 'Pending Warehouse Dispatch' and the customer left to chase the third-party courier depot herself.

grader.scenario: Order for S-Net Ultra TV multi-room mini box stuck in 'Pending Warehouse Dispatch' for 10 days
grader.notes: Hard-case B FAIL (near-miss 'thank you for contacting S-Net' at [00:00]), hard-case E PASS ([00:18], [02:06]) and PA PASS ([01:12]-[01:28]), paired with hard-case O FAIL ([04:18] deflecting to DHL depot) and PR FAIL ([05:37]-[05:55] no probing into pre-dispatch holds or contract acceptance).

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: [00:00] Agent: 'Good morning, thank you for contacting S-Net customer support today.' (Near-miss opening branding; closing at [12:38]/[12:50] included 'Thank you for choosing S-Net'.)

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: [02:27]-[03:29] Single managed hold of 52s properly announced with 'bear with me for a moment while' and concluded with 'Thank you for holding'.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: [00:56]-[01:06] Agent verified the first line of the home address and four-digit security PIN within the first four minutes.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: [00:18] Agent addressed the customer by her name ('Evangeline') throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [00:18] Agent: 'I am so sorry that you have been left waiting ten days for your bedroom mini box, Evangeline, and I completely understand how frustrating it is when an order is delayed.' Also [02:06].

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [01:12]-[01:28] Agent: 'So just to make sure I have everything straight, you placed order ORD-774190 ten days ago on the eighth of October for an additional Ultra TV multi-room mini box... and the online portal has been stuck showing Pending Warehouse Dispatch with no courier tracking details generated.'

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [01:12], [02:06], [06:15] Agent accurately retained the order reference ORD-774190, the eighth of October order date, the bedroom setup for her recovering husband, and the address 14 Ravenswood Gardens.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [04:18] Agent: 'Our third-party logistics partner DHL handles the warehouse dispatch queue, there's nothing I can do from this desk—you'd have to contact their customer depot directly.'

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [00:18], [02:06], [12:38] Agent remained polite, calm, and wished the customer's husband a smooth recovery.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: [05:26]-[05:55] When the customer asked if an account block, out-of-stock flag, or unaccepted agreement was holding the order back, the agent did not probe or check pre-dispatch flags and simply blamed the warehouse feed.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [12:22]-[12:35] Customer confirmed the bedroom mini box order remained unresolved and stuck in Pending Warehouse Dispatch.
